faq.1.title: Why do I need WordPress maintenance services?
faq.1.description: WordPress maintenance is essential for keeping your website secure, fast, and functional. Regular updates, security monitoring, and performance optimization prevent security breaches, improve user experience, and ensure your site continues to work properly as WordPress and plugins evolve.
faq.2.title: What happens if my WordPress site gets hacked?
faq.2.description: If your WordPress site gets compromised, we provide immediate malware removal and security restoration services. Our monitoring system detects threats early, and our backup system ensures we can quickly restore your site to a clean state with minimal downtime.
faq.3.title: How often do you update WordPress sites?
faq.3.description: We perform WordPress core updates as soon as they're released and deemed stable. Plugin and theme updates are handled weekly or as needed. Critical security updates are applied immediately to ensure your site stays protected.
faq.4.title: Will updates break my website?
faq.4.description: We follow strict testing procedures before applying any updates. We create backups before each update and test functionality to minimize the risk of issues. If problems occur, we can quickly restore from backup and resolve any conflicts.
faq.5.title: How much do WordPress maintenance services cost?
faq.5.description: Our pricing depends on the number of websites you need maintained and the level of service required. We offer flexible plans starting from €7/month for basic maintenance up to €69/year for enterprise-level unlimited site management. All plans include essential security monitoring and updates.
faq.6.title: Do you provide backups for my WordPress site?
faq.6.description: Yes, all our maintenance plans include automated backups. Depending on your plan level, we provide daily, weekly, or monthly backups stored securely off-site. You can request backup restoration at any time, and we maintain backup history for easy recovery.
faq.7.title: What if I need help with my WordPress site?
faq.7.description: All our maintenance plans include expert support from our WordPress specialists. You can contact us via email, live chat, or our support portal. Higher-tier plans include priority support with faster response times and phone support options.
faq.8.title: Can you help optimize my WordPress site speed?
faq.8.description: Absolutely! Performance optimization is included in our Premium and Enterprise plans. We optimize images, implement caching, clean up databases, optimize code, and configure CDN services to ensure your WordPress site loads as quickly as possible for better user experience and SEO.

refund.title: Refund Policy
refund.subTitle: Refund Policy
refund.description1: At Genova Tech ('we,' 'our,' or 'us'), we strive to provide high-quality WordPress maintenance, security, and SEO services to our customers. We understand that there may be situations where a refund is warranted. This Refund Policy outlines our guidelines and procedures for requesting and processing refunds for our services.
refund.description3: Refund requests are subject to the following conditions:
refund.description4: Quality Concerns: If you are dissatisfied with the quality of our WordPress maintenance or SEO services or believe they were not delivered as promised, you may be eligible for a refund.
refund.description5: Cancellation: If you decide to cancel your subscription before the service period has ended, you may be eligible for a refund based on the unused portion of the service.
refund.description6: Non-Delivery: If unforeseen circumstances prevent us from delivering the services you've purchased, you may be eligible for a full refund.
refund.description8: To request a refund, please follow these steps:
refund.description9: Contact Us: Reach out to our customer support team at support@genova-tech.uk within [refund request period] days of the service purchase or subscription cancellation. Include your name, email address, order number, and a detailed explanation of the reason for your refund request.
refund.description10: Assessment: Our team will review your request and assess its eligibility based on the conditions outlined above. We may require additional information to process your request.
refund.description11: Refund Decision: Once the assessment is complete, we will notify you of our refund decision via email. If your refund request is approved, we will initiate the refund according to the original payment method.
refund.description13: Refund processing times may vary depending on the payment method and financial institution. Here's a general guideline:
refund.description14: Credit/Debit Card: Refunds to credit or debit cards typically take 3 to 7 days to be reflected in your account.
refund.description15: Bank Transfer: Refunds to bank accounts may take 3 to 7 days to appear in your account, depending on your bank's processing time.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subTitle: Privacy Policy
privacy.description1: Welcome to Genova Tech ('we,' 'our,' or 'us'). We are committed to protecting the privacy and security of your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our website and WordPress maintenance, security, and SEO services. By accessing or using our website and services, you consent to the practices described in this Privacy Policy.
privacy.description2: Personal Information: When you visit our website, subscribe to our services, or make a payment through Stripe, we may collect certain personal information such as your name, email address, billing address, and payment information.
privacy.description3: Usage Information: We may collect information about how you interact with our website, the services you use, and the pages you visit. This information may include your IP address, browser type, operating system, and referring URLs.
privacy.description5: Provide Services: We use the information you provide to deliver the WordPress maintenance, security, and SEO services you've requested and to communicate with you about your account.
privacy.description6: Process Payments: For payment processing, we use Stripe as our payment gateway. We do not store your payment information on our servers. Stripe handles all payment processing, and you can review their privacy policy for more information.
privacy.description7: Improve Services: We analyze usage data to improve our website and services, enhance user experience, and identify trends and preferences.
privacy.description8: Communications: We may use your contact information to send you updates, newsletters, and marketing materials about our services. You can opt out of receiving marketing communications at any time.
privacy.description10: We implement a variety of security measures to safeguard your personal information. However, no method of transmission over the internet or electronic storage is completely secure. We cannot guarantee absolute security, but we strive to protect your information to the best of our abilities.
privacy.description12: We do not sell, trade, or otherwise transfer your personal information to third parties without your consent, except as described below:
privacy.description13: Service Providers: We may share your information with third-party service providers who assist us in operating our website and providing services to you.
privacy.description14: Legal Compliance: We may disclose your information to comply with legal obligations, protect our rights, and ensure the safety of others.
privacy.description15: Business Transfers: If we are involved in a merger, acquisition, or sale of all or a portion of our assets, your information may be transferred as part of that transaction.
privacy.description17: Opt-Out: You can opt out of receiving marketing communications from us by following the unsubscribe instructions provided in the communication.
privacy.description18: Access and Update: You can review and update your personal information by logging into your account or contacting us directly.
privacy.description20: Our services are not intended for individuals under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13 years of age.
privacy.description22: We may update this Privacy Policy to reflect changes in our practices or for legal reasons. The updated version will be posted on our website with a revised 'Last Updated' date.
